_comment: Non-secret settings only. Copy to config/genesys-connector.json (git-ignored) and edit. Credentials NEVER go here: use the GENESYS_CLIENT_ID and GENESYS_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables.
defaultQuestion: How likely are you to recommend us from zero to ten?
_detection: Surveys are detected automatically. Participant-data keys matching surveyKeyPattern are classified by name (utterance, score, confidence, status...). Only set 'attributes' to pin a key the automatic detection does not recognise; leave a value empty to auto-detect it.
